scenes.tts: You need about four and a half meters of string, four sticks for corners, and a pencil for parting the grass. A magnifying glass helps.
scenes.narration: You need about four and a half meters of string, four sticks for corners, and a pencil for parting the grass. A magnifying glass helps.

scenes.tts: Push the four sticks into the ground about one meter apart. Wrap the string around them to make a square. Guess how many animals live inside.
scenes.narration: Push the four sticks into the ground about one meter apart. Wrap the string around them to make a square. Guess how many animals live inside.

scenes.tts: Kneel down and look closely for ten minutes. Expect ants, spiders, small beetles, pill bugs, or earthworms, depending on the season and weather.
scenes.narration: Kneel down and look closely for ten minutes. Expect ants, spiders, small beetles, pill bugs, or earthworms, depending on the season and weather.

scenes.tts: Stay within arm's reach the whole time. An adult rolls any log or rock. Never put hands or feet where you cannot see. Touch no animals. If you see a snake, step back and let it go.

items.text: Stay close. Look, do not touch.
